current_behavior: Sample-by-feature observation matrix.
rationale: Required data input.

current_behavior: Single-ordering initialization method; vector means candidate starts for M=1 but per-ordering methods for M>=2.
rationale: Use a scalar common method in the ordinary interface; expose per-ordering overrides and multi-start fitting separately.

current_behavior: Number of discrete latent-position states; automatic request is max(2,min(50,floor(N/5))); realized single-ordering grids can shrink when initialization cuts collapse.
rationale: Document requested versus realized count and retain internal K notation.

current_behavior: Random-walk order of the trajectory smoothness prior.
rationale: Keep default 2; changing it changes the trajectory prior.

current_behavior: Initial smoothness precision, or fixed smoothness when fix_lambda is true; supports feature/order-specific values.
rationale: Do not imply that this is a final smoothing value when precision is estimated.

current_behavior: Known measurement standard deviations by feature or observation; supplied values replace estimated noise variances.
rationale: Preserve measurement-error support.

current_behavior: Initial noise variance, scalar or feature vector; incompatible with supplied S.
rationale: Automatic initialization is sufficient for ordinary calls.

current_behavior: Disable smoothness-precision updates and retain supplied values.
rationale: Preserve fixed-versus-estimated smoothness as an advanced scientific choice.

applies_to: M=1; fallback final budget for M>=2
current_behavior: Single-ordering sweep cap; used as the final T=1 partition cap when max_converge_iter is NULL.
rationale: One stopping-phase sweep cap for both inference paths; annealing budget remains separate.

current_behavior: ELBO-change tolerance; default scale is absolute ELBO change divided by N times D.
rationale: Use the same named tolerance for single and partition stopping; zero disables early stopping.

current_behavior: Enables multiple-method fitting only when greater than one; otherwise the wrapper fits only the first method.
rationale: Worker count should control execution speed rather than which fits exist.

current_behavior: Requested model ordering slots, or auto similarity-cut initialization.
rationale: Retain intrinsic-dimension terminology; model_intrinsic_dim records retained dimensions and intrinsic_dim reports effective dimension.

current_behavior: Only none is accepted; forward and backward immediately error.
rationale: Keep the active search in select_mpcurve_dimension; remove its internal greedy=none call when changing the wrapper.

current_behavior: Initialize from feature-similarity blocks or orderings computed from the common full matrix.
rationale: Retain the alternative while dimension selection explicitly compares both initialization paths.

current_behavior: Quantile, equal-width or k-means discretization of initial ordering scores; NULL resolves to quantile.
rationale: Retain advanced initialization/reproduction control.

current_behavior: Diagonal addition to random-walk precision; positive values make the prior proper.
rationale: This changes the prior and is not merely numerical Cholesky jitter.

current_behavior: Optional exponential prior on inverse square root of smoothness precision; NULL or zero disables it.
rationale: Additional model regularization; retain only as an explicitly documented advanced option.

current_behavior: Lower bound for smoothness precision.
rationale: Merge min/max into one advanced bounds setting.

current_behavior: Upper bound for smoothness precision.
rationale: Merge min/max into one advanced bounds setting.

current_behavior: Lower bound for noise variance sigma squared, despite the sigma name.
rationale: Rename to make variance units explicit and merge min/max.

current_behavior: Upper bound for noise variance sigma squared, despite the sigma name.
rationale: Rename to make variance units explicit and merge min/max.

current_behavior: Estimate position-bin probabilities or keep them fixed; fixed with no weights means uniform.
rationale: Scientifically meaningful and independent of the feature-assignment prior.

current_behavior: Initial or fixed K-vector of position probabilities; broadcast over orderings for M>=2.
rationale: Keep custom position priors as an advanced scientific option.

current_behavior: Empirical-Bayes ordering probabilities or fixed probabilities; fixed with no weights means uniform.
rationale: Preserve adaptive EB and fixed-uniform dimension-selection routes.

current_behavior: Custom fixed M-vector of ordering probabilities; ignored by adaptive EB initialization.
rationale: Rename to reflect the current fixed-prior-only behavior.

current_behavior: Counts fitted prior weights above the threshold; does not change posterior inference.
rationale: The accepted reporting threshold is in expected feature counts (default 1e-8); the equivalent adaptive-prior cutoff scales as count_tol / ncol(X).

current_behavior: Deprecated uniform alias or a live legacy Dirichlet-assignment model.
rationale: Uniform maps to fixed partition_prior; Dirichlet is a distinct model, not an alias for adaptive EB.

current_behavior: Dirichlet prior concentration; changes assignment posterior and ELBO.
rationale: Retire with the legacy assignment model; it is not a no-op in fit_mpcurve.

current_behavior: Spearman, Pearson, smooth-fit evidence or spline R-squared; numeric M defaults to Spearman while auto defaults to spline R-squared.
rationale: Consider one documented spline-R-squared default only after validating the changed numeric-M initialization.

current_behavior: Optimize directional smoother precision or keep it fixed.
rationale: Retirement of the smooth-fit metric would remove this option; no retirement decision yet.

current_behavior: Fixed or initial directional smoother precision.
rationale: Retirement of the smooth-fit metric would remove this option; no retirement decision yet.

current_behavior: Hierarchical-clustering linkage on one minus feature similarity.
rationale: Single linkage remains the default; alternative linkage changes initialization.

current_behavior: Flags columns whose raw sample SD is below the threshold; zeros their off-diagonal similarities without removing them from fitting.
rationale: Absolute units affect this guard; review it together with the additional absolute spline residual-variance guard before fixing a new internal rule.

current_behavior: Starting feature-assignment annealing temperature.
rationale: Default 5; meaningful optimizer initialization setting.

current_behavior: Final annealing temperature; the following convergence phase always runs at T=1.
rationale: A separately configurable schedule endpoint complicates the interface; fixing it preserves the current default schedule.

current_behavior: Number of temperature schedule points; each is followed by inner_iter joint sweeps.
rationale: New default 0 skips annealing; positive values enable the advanced schedule.

current_behavior: Joint structural CAVI sweeps at each temperature.
rationale: Default is one; consider keeping multiple sweeps only in the advanced low-level engine.

current_behavior: Maximum additional joint sweeps at T=1 after annealing; NULL inherits iter.
rationale: Remove the duplicated user-facing final fitting budget.

current_behavior: ELBO-change tolerance checked during the final T=1 phase after annealing.
rationale: Same estimand and default threshold as the single-ordering tolerance.

current_behavior: Print iteration progress.
rationale: Common low-cost interface control.
